title: Lo Shu Magic Square
tagline: The ancient Chinese magic square, from 3 x 3 to 5 x 5.
description: Place the numbers so every row, column and diagonal adds up to the magic number. Start with the original Lo Shu, then climb to 4 x 4 and 5 x 5 squares and broken-diagonal variants. Hints that teach, a Daily Square and Watch and Learn. Portrait or landscape.
howToPlay: Fill the grid so every row, column and diagonal adds up to the same magic number.
Tap a stone in the tray, then tap a square, or drag it there.
Gauges at the end of every line show the running total and glow when it is right.
Tap the lamp for a hint: where to look, then why it works.
Climb the Journey, pick any size in Free Play, or play the Daily Square.
